support.quote:
That suggests the precipitate is AgCl (which dissolves in ammonia forming [Ag(NH3)2]+). Ag2SO4 is not soluble in ammonia, would not dissolve. Partial dissolution suggests maybe mixture of AgCl and something else? But earlier we had white precipitate with AgNO3, not dissolving in HCl (AgCl is insoluble in HCl, correct)... So anion likely Cl-.

But Ba(NO3)2 test gave no precipitate. BaCl2 would give white precipitate with Cl-? Actually BaCl2 is soluble; BaCl2 is soluble, but Ba2+ with Cl- does not precipitate. BaSO4 precipitates with sulfate. No precipitate suggests not sulfate.

Therefore the anion is Cl⁻, and the unknown salt is sodium chloride.
